Nigeria is projected to be the world's most affected country by the excess heatwave (Super El Nino).

A new report by the Climate Impact Lab predicts that the heatwave could cause 31,400 deaths in the country with the Sahel Region predicted to record 66,800 deaths as a whole.

Somalia's Government has presented a bill to the Parliament to formally ban Female Genital Mutilation (FGM).

99% of women in the country have undergone the practice, which involves the deplorable act of cutting a woman's clitoris.
